# Ray of Frost: The Brittle Lance

To invoke the *Ray of Frost* is to command the absolute stillness of the void. As the caster shapes the Weave, the sensation is one of sudden, jagged crystallization—as if the very air in one’s lungs has turned to powdered glass. One must draw the ambient warmth from the surroundings, focusing it into a singular, shivering point of negation.

The spell manifests as a streak of blinding, cerulean light, trailing a wake of glittering rime. It does not merely strike; it saps the kinetic soul of the target, anchoring their limbs with a sudden, bone-deep lethargy.

### The Legend of the Shivered Rose
Loremasters trace this cantrip to Lady Elara of the High Peaks. It is said she sought to preserve a single, dying rose—a final gift from a fallen knight. In her grief-stricken attempt to halt time’s decay, she pulled the heat from her own chamber so violently that the rose shattered into diamond-dust. She failed to save the flower, but in her sorrow, she gifted all mages the power to command the biting touch of the eternal winter.
